scope: Repair only the four armed-confirm captures and their eight bound failed axis occurrences. Preserve the corrected actor/action copy and every authority, placement, control, threshold, and exposure contract.

bound_failure_set.finding: The four original-resolution captures show a bare checkmark and bare right arrow, not independently recognizable focus_chevron, selected_check_diamond, and confirm_double_frame_plus_enter_arrow shapes.

copy_freeze.actor_source: Preserve the exact actor_display derived from the current stable offer actor_player_id.
copy_freeze.action_source: Preserve the exact localized action result already shown by the corrected v3 armed and confirm rows.
requirements: Both armed and confirm rows continue to name the exact actor and exact action result.
No generic confirm copy, local-player fallback, action alias, reorder, truncation, ellipsis, or stale actor/action carry-over.
No wording, localization, line-break, authority revision, or submission semantic change is authorized by this gate.

focus_chevron.required_geometry: A standalone leading-edge chevron formed by two joined diagonal strokes, attached only to the keyboard/pointer-focused row.
focus_chevron.placement: Inside the focused confirm-row hit rectangle at its leading edge; never in the Player HUD region or at the trailing selected/confirm token slot.

selected_check_diamond.required_geometry: A visible check glyph fully enclosed by a closed four-sided diamond outline; a bare checkmark is a blocking failure.
selected_check_diamond.placement: Inside the armed action-row hit rectangle at its trailing token slot and absent from unselected/open rows.

confirm_double_frame_plus_enter_arrow.required_geometry: Two closed nested rectangular frames enclosing a bent enter-arrow glyph; a bare straight/right arrow is a blocking failure.
confirm_double_frame_plus_enter_arrow.placement: Inside the explicit confirm-control hit rectangle at its trailing token slot and absent from action/open/status/error rows.

simultaneous_capture_contract: The armed-confirm fixture pins focus to the explicit confirm control without submitting, so all three shape roles are visible in the same capture.
The focused confirm row shows the leading focus chevron and trailing double-frame enter-arrow; the armed action row simultaneously shows the trailing enclosed check-diamond.
Each token has a distinct token_id, draw-command range, physical bounding box, and semantic role; aliasing one geometry or glyph across roles is forbidden.
Standard and color_vision_safe palettes expose the same three-shape inventory and geometry. Hue may supplement, never replace, shape/text/luminance distinction.
repair_contract.submission_semantics_unchanged: First activation arms only; only a separate activation of the explicit confirm control submits once. Focus, hover, open, Escape, right-click, double-click, timeout, resume, and focus loss never submit.

allowed_modification_categories.boundary: Only the three v4 Rules UI token definitions and their geometry/metrics; no shared Player HUD diamond, shell, placement, error, pending, or status token mutation.
Only focus/selected/confirm shape draw commands, role IDs, and bounded row-local placement for group_choice_armed_confirm.
Only generic line/frame primitives needed to rasterize the three scoped token geometries after ACES tone map; no gameplay/world/placement raster path change.
CPU/static assertions, 540-case machine assertions, targeted evidence validation, and fail-closed tests only.

authority_and_rules: No offered action inventory/order, branch, actor, ruleset, clause, policy, foundation action, authority hash/revision, request/ACK identity, error mapping, idempotency, mutation, turn, score, rack, breaker, group, entitlement, or validation change.
copy_and_submission: No corrected actor/action copy change and no arm/confirm/cancel/focus/submit semantic change.
thresholds: No contrast, typography, critical-shape, stroke, hit-target, safe-area, layout, occlusion, ui-scale, viewport/density, performance, draw-call, or evidence threshold relaxation.
placement: No ghost cue-ball, crosshair, error-cross-octagon, dashed collision ring, behind-head hatch, boundary, in-world region/scope text, coordinate, geometry, or placement-confirm change.
regression_controls: No selected/focus/confirm token leakage into group-choice open, shared action, submitting, authority-error, pending, stale, disabled, or unoffered states.
No Player HUD diamond mutation or use as proof of the row-local selected-check-diamond.
evidence_and_exposure: Do not overwrite any v2/v3 PPM, PNG, receipt, manifest, or manual evidence.

No GPU authorization or execution, implementation pass, manual pass, scoped gate pass, product exposure, profile complete, Golden, M2, Beta, real-input, screen-reader, localization/CVD-human, or external-QA promotion by this design gate.

cpu_and_machine_gate.required_reproducibility: Two clean offline runs must produce byte-identical ordered 540-case JSON and aggregate SHA.
required_checks: All inherited 540-case authority/action/copy/layout/contrast/performance checks remain enabled and unchanged.
The four armed-confirm matrix corners emit three distinct token IDs with non-overlapping semantic roles and row-local bounding boxes.

Every emitted focus chevron, selected check-diamond, and confirm double-frame enter-arrow reports physical width/height, stroke widths, enclosure/frame closure, and standard/CVD shape inventory equality.
The current corrected actor/action strings and hit rectangles remain byte/geometry stable.
All open/unselected, placement, status, error, pending, stale, disabled, and unoffered states reject v4 token leakage.
Any token alias, bare check, bare straight/right arrow, missing chevron, open diamond/frame, undersized geometry, threshold drift, or unrelated raster change is blocking FAIL.
implementation_preflight_before_any_gpu_: Source and binary bindings are frozen after 540/540 reproducible machine PASS.
CPU/static inspection proves the diff belongs only to allowed modification categories.
A new readiness package records 16 NOT_RUN targeted cases and does not reuse prior authorization/evidence.

capture_requirements: Use a new v4 evidence root and a fresh process under one separately issued single-use root authorization.
Capture the production Core 4.1 product_ui path after ACES tone map with shipping fonts/icons; no CPU/mock/design image substitutes for actual GPU evidence.

Record PPM and PNG path/SHA/decoded physical dimensions, stable aggregates, source/runner/binary bindings, draw-command token IDs, physical shape bounding boxes/strokes, hit rectangles, and render-pass order.
All 16 captures pass machine validation; any missing shape, token leakage, placement-overlay regression, dimension/threshold failure, or omitted-corner anomaly is blocking.
future_targeted_actual_gpu_gate.proof_boundary: 16/16 targeted actual-GPU machine pass closes only the v4 exact-shape raster and sampled regression check. It does not equal TA pass, full scoped gate pass, product exposure, Golden, M2, Beta, real-input, screen-reader, localization/CVD-human, or external-QA pass.

technical_art_re_review_gate.reviewer: Independent technical-art reviewer who did not implement the v4 correction.
method: Open all 16 bound PNGs individually at original physical resolution.
Review every image on all ten canonical axes to detect regression; no machine PASS is inherited as manual PASS.
For the four repaired armed-confirm cases, explicitly verify the eight bound failed axis occurrences and the simultaneous visibility/independence of all three exact shapes.
Compare standard/CVD profiles and confirm the Player HUD diamond is not counted as the row-local selected-check-diamond.
Any prior failed axis remaining FAIL or any new regression makes the v4 TA result FAIL.

implementation_may_start_when: All four read-only binding hashes and both frozen v3 stable aggregates match.
The implementation diff is restricted to the four allowed modification categories and exact group_choice_armed_confirm scope.
Authority/rules, corrected copy, inherited thresholds, placement overlays, regression controls, evidence, and exposure boundaries remain unchanged.
scoped_v4_raster_may_pass_when: 540/540 offline machine cases pass twice with byte-identical aggregate SHA.
A separately authorized fresh 16/16 targeted actual-GPU set passes machine validation.
Independent TA reviews 16/16 original-resolution PNGs and 160/160 axes; all eight prior failures become PASS with zero regressions.
